Status Detail.value: Applied Digital's quarterly report for the three months ended August 2026 says Applied Digital signed a power purchase agreement with Base Electron on October 4, 2026 for about 1,200 MW from a natural gas plant in Center, North Dakota. The agreement lets Base Electron end it if financial close has not happened by March 31, 2027. An Oliver County commission story from October 15, 2026 says the county rezoned the land to industrial and approved a conditional use permit for the plant, but held the building permit until state permits, road use and water and gas routing are settled.
Status Detail.note: The Applied Digital quarterly report at https://ir.applieddigital.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001144879-26-000059/apld-20260831.htm and the Citizen Portal story at https://citizenportal.ai/articles/11129926/north-dakota/oliver-county/oliver-county-approves-zoning-and-cup-for-base-electron-power-plant-building-permit-tabled are two separate publishers. The unit stays in pre-construction because the building permit is not yet issued and financing has not closed.

Backup Power.note: The Applied Digital quarterly report at https://ir.applieddigital.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001144879-26-000059/apld-20260831.htm describes the plant as dedicated generation for the Polaris Forge 3 campus under a 15 year power purchase agreement. It does not call any unit backup power, so the current value of no fits. The report never uses the words backup power for this plant.

units.notes: No start year is given for the plant. Applied Digital expects the data center to begin operating in August 2027, but no document gives a date for the power units. The project is moving, so Latest Activity is left alone.

qa.question: Is the Sierra Club's Applied Digital Natural Gas Plant units 1 to 4 this plant?
qa.finding: Only Base Electron has four 300 MW natural gas steam units in North Dakota. Polaris Forge 1 is 400 MW and Polaris Forge 2 is 280 MW in GEM, and the Applied Digital engine plants are 3 MW diesel engine sets.
qa.recommendation: Treat the Sierra Club row as Base Electron power station and add no new plant for it.
qa.note: The Babcock and Wilcox release at https://www.babcock.com/home/about/corporate/news/babcock-and-wilcox-receives-full-notice-to-proceed-on-24-billion-power-generation-project-for-base-electron-to-supply-power-to-applied-digital-ai-factory-campuses gives four 300 MW boilers with steam turbines for Applied Digital campuses, and the quarterly report at https://ir.applieddigital.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001144879-26-000059/apld-20260831.htm ties the 1,200 MW plant to Polaris Forge 3. I could not open the Sierra Club list as a citable source, so this rests on the matching size and unit count.

qa.question: Can the Base Electron point be improved beyond GEM's approximate point near Center?
qa.finding: Montana-Dakota Utilities filings PU-26-219 and PU-26-236 place the Applied Digital campus in Section 24, Township 142 North, Range 85 West, Oliver County, west of Center. GEM's point is 47.09400, -101.27980, about 2.9 km from the town of Center at 47.11639, -101.29959.
qa.recommendation: Leave the point as approximate. A person should convert the section and township to a point or find the county conditional use permit 1105 site map.
qa.note: The filings are at https://www.psc.nd.gov/webdocs/case/26-0219/ and https://www.psc.nd.gov/webdocs/case/26-0236/. I did not convert the survey description into coordinates or look at satellite imagery, and the campus is not confirmed to be the power plant site. The Oliver County permit documents were behind a sign-in page.

monitor.monitor_reason: Applied Digital is only evaluating an option for another 1.2 GW with Base Electron, so there is no committed second phase.
monitor.note: The Babcock and Wilcox release at https://www.babcock.com/home/about/corporate/news/babcock-and-wilcox-receives-full-notice-to-proceed-on-24-billion-power-generation-project-for-base-electron-to-supply-power-to-applied-digital-ai-factory-campuses says Applied Digital is evaluating an option for another 1.2 GW. Recheck when financial close is due on March 31, 2027.
